{{Quote|My triumph is at hand, Lieutenant; I've seen it in my dreams. The galaxy is mine.|Ralchio Nervi|<ref name="Friends" />}}
'''Ralchio Nervi''', [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] '''Ralchio Sargan''', was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|naval forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who was in command of a [[Ralchio Nervi's task force/Legends|task force]] that consisted of the [[Blood Ambition/Legends|''Blood Ambition'']], the [[Sargantuan/Legends|''Sargantuan'']], and the [[Warhawk/Legends|''Warhawk'']]. He fought in the [[Battle of Xorrn/Legends|Battle of Xorrn]], and coordinated his fleet with his ground forces led by [[Lieutenant Colonel/Legends|Lieutenant Colonel]] [[Erle Hovlinn/Legends|Erle Hovlinn]].

Nervi was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], although he kept that secret to himself. The [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] [[Marriage/Legends|married]] Lilva Nervi and took her name in wanting to obtain more social influence, shortly before attending the [[Rengali Imperial Naval Academy]]. He graduated with mediocre marks, but held records for winning head-to-head combat simulations. Having became married to a Lilva, Ralchio Nervi used this leverage to attain a promotion under [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Ravik/Legends|Ravik]]. It was rumored that the Imperial kept [[Prostitute/Legends|mistresses]], however.<ref name="Friends" />
